name: the_second_sheet_does_not_repeat_the_dimensions
why: Z-C21.10, finding N43 (lot Z-C21.2). drawing_dimension skips an extent of the part that is already dimensioned, and the catalogue promises «UNA QUOTA SOLA PER ELEMENTO IN TUTTA LA TAVOLA» (UNI ISO 129-1: each element is dimensioned once). But ChiaviGiaQuotate walked the views from IDrawingDoc.GetFirstView, and IDrawingDoc~GetFirstView.html says «Gets the first drawing view on the current sheet.»: a second sheet with a view of the same part never saw the dimensions of the first, and got the 120 and the 10 again. The fix reads the views of every sheet with IDrawingDoc.GetViews (IDrawingDoc~GetViews.html: «an array of arrays with a length equal to the number of sheets»), keeping only the views of the same model and configuration.
defect_caught: Step 8 dimensions the top view of the SECOND sheet, whose 120 is already dimensioned in the front view of the FIRST sheet (step 5). The 120 must be skipped and said, and only the 80 placed: on library 0.140.0 the first expectation of step 8 is RED, because sheet 1 is never read and the 120 is placed a second time (2 dimensions, 120 and 80). Step 9 asks the front view of the second sheet, whose 120 and 10 are both on sheet 1: it must refuse as «already dimensioned», the same call that succeeds in step 5 on a drawing where nothing is dimensioned yet. «views_of_other_models_not_counted» = 0 is the other half: the model filter must recognise the views of sheet 1 as the same part, or the fix would do nothing and still look green on a one-sheet drawing.
_and_the_twin_is_in_the_same_file: The refusal (step 9) and step 5 are the same call, «view: V1, quante: 6», on the same part: the difference is the drawing, which in step 9 already carries the 120 and the 10 on the first sheet («la_differenza_e_il_pezzo»).
_the_numbers: Plate 120 x 80 x 10 = 96000 mm3, centred, extruded up from the top plane: X from -60 to 60 (the 120), Y from 0 to 10 (the 10), Z from -40 to 40 (the 80). standard_views gives front (X and Y), top (X and Z), side (Z and Y), in this order (measured in `drawing_dimensions_holes_and_chamfer`). Sheet 1, front view: 120 and 10, 2 dimensions (the same step as in `drawing_dimensions_holes_and_chamfer`). Sheet 2, top view: the 120 has the model key X|-60.00|60.00, the same as on sheet 1, so it is skipped; the two 80 edges are one element (Z|-40.00|40.00): 1 dimension. Sheet 2, front view: 120 (X|-60.00|60.00) and 10 (Y|0.00|10.00), both on sheet 1: 0 dimensions, refused. On 0.140.0 the top view of sheet 2 gets 2 dimensions, 120 and 80.
